Slide.title: Slide
Slide.description: Promotional slideshow banner item managed by NJR CELL admins and displayed on the homepage.

title.description: Headline title of the promotional slide.

subtitle.description: Caption or description text explaining the promo.

category.description: Category tab for filtering on the homepage.

buttonText.description: Label text displayed inside the CTA button.

targetUrl.description: Validated https/http destination URL when the CTA button is clicked.

imageUrl.description: Image source URL (local asset path, Firebase Storage download URL, or optimized WebP/JPEG data URL).

storagePath.description: Firebase Storage path if uploaded to Cloud Storage (empty string if local or inline optimized image).

alt.description: Accessible alt text for the banner image.

order.description: Display sort order (ascending integer from 1 to 999).

startAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string for scheduled start time, or empty string for immediate.

endAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string for scheduled expiration time, or empty string for no expiration.

authorUid.description: UID of the admin who created the slide.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the slide was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the slide was last updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

addedByUid.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/slides/{slideId}.description: Promotional slideshow banners. Public visitors may only read documents where status == 'Published'. Only verified admins may read non-published slides or create/update/delete slides.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Authorized administrator registry. Strictly readable and writable only by verified admins.
